descriptionChirho: Gentilic adjective derived from Korah (qorach), designating members of the Levitical clan descended from Korah son of Izhar. Always used with the article. Appears in collective singular (Exod 6:24 the Korahites as a clan; 1 Chr 9:31 the Korahite as individual gatekeeper), and in plural forms (1 Chr 9:19 the Korahites as gatekeepers; 12:7; 26:19 Korahites in military/temple roles; 2 Chr 20:19 Korahite singers). This clan is prominently associated with temple gatekeeping duties and the Psalms of the sons of Korah. Glossed as 'the Korahite(s)' (eng), 'القورحي' (arb), '고라 사람(들)' (kor), 'los coraitas/el coraita' (spa), 'कोरही' (hin).
